title: Starfall Radiance

outfit_card.silhouette: A multi-layered ballgown with a high ruffled bonnet collar, voluminous puff sleeves, a fitted corset-style bodice, and a full A-line skirt with a sheer tulle overskirt cascading into a gentle train.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A ruffled dark lace bonnet with sheer organza trim, accented by a fabric rosette and cascading ribbon ties, worn over a delicate lace headband.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A dark velvet-like bodice with a high ruffled neckline, sheer lace overlay forming a sweetheart illusion, a jeweled brooch at the center, and large puff sleeves with lace cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A layered skirt with a dark central panel decorated with star embroidery, a pleated white petticoat beneath, and a sheer tulle overskirt with glittering star motifs.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating star-shaped sparkles and a delicate handheld wand with a star finial, complementing the celestial theme.
